title: Bledsoe tries to call in UAP on Capitol lawn

tellings.quote: the Capitol lawn and and um he did his thing and I kind of just politely quietly sat and waited

plain: In the 2020s a man named Chris Bledsoe, who says he can call in unexplained craft, tried to summon some on the lawn of the US Capitol in Washington DC. A US congressman named Eric Burlison says he was there: Bledsoe "did his thing", while Burlison "politely quietly sat and waited". UAP is the official term for unexplained objects in the sky.
